description: Ingest pipeline to process crawler data from https://2e.aonprd.com/

drop.description: Drop soft-404 pages that return HTTP 200

gsub.pattern: - Archives of Nethys: Pathfinder 2nd Edition Database

grok.description: Extracts better_title from h1.title in full_html when CSS extraction rule missed it

gsub.description: Strip trailing ' - Category' from title when better_title not available

script.description: Extracts price_gp from body_content: parses 'Price N gp/sp/cp/pp' (with optional multi-denomination like '1 gp, 5 sp') and converts to gold pieces

split.description: Splits the string stored in "spell_list" to an array

grok.description: Extracts action cost from crawler's action_cost extraction rule (h1.title span.action)

script.source: if (ctx['headings'] != null) { for (String h : ctx['headings']) { def m = /\[(one-action|two-actions|three-actions|free-action|reaction)\]/.matcher(h); if (m.find()) { ctx['num_actions'] = m.group(1); break; } } }
script.description: Extracts action cost from headings array

grok.description: Extracts action cost from subtitle if not already found in headings

script.source: if (ctx['full_html'] != null) { def m = /class=['"]action['"][^>]*>\[(one-action|two-actions|three-actions|free-action|reaction)\]/.matcher(ctx['full_html']); if (m.find()) { ctx['num_actions'] = m.group(1); } }
script.description: Extracts action cost from full_html action span (covers Spells and other pages where headings/subtitle lack the marker)

grok.description: Extracts item level from Equipment/Shields pages
Extracts feat level from Feats pages
Extracts creature level from margin-left:auto span on Monsters pages
Extracts creature size from traitsize span on Monsters pages

script.description: Sets prerequisites_flag when full_html contains a Prerequisites stat block label
Sets requirements_flag when body_content mentions Requirements

script.source: if (ctx['full_html'] != null) { def m = /class="trait(uncommon|rare|unique)"/.matcher(ctx['full_html']); if (m.find()) { ctx['rarity'] = m.group(1).substring(0,1).toUpperCase() + m.group(1).substring(1); } }
script.description: Extracts rarity (Uncommon/Rare/Unique) from full_html trait span CSS classes; Common items have no rarity span

script.source: if (ctx['full_html'] != null) { def m = /<b>Source<\/b> <a [^>]+><i>([^<]+) pg\. \d+<\/i>/.matcher(ctx['full_html']); if (m.find()) { ctx['source_book'] = m.group(1); } }
script.description: Extracts source publication name (e.g. 'Core Rulebook') from full_html stat block source link
Compute spell_level_bucket: single-level buckets Level 1 through Level 10
Compute feat_level_bucket: every-2-level ranges Levels 1-2 through Levels 19-20
Compute item_level_bucket: Level 0 alone, Levels 1-2 through 19-20, Level 21+
Compute creature_level_bucket: Level -1 to 0, Levels 1-4, 5-8, 9-12, 13-16, 17-21, Level 22+

remove.description: Classes don't have traits; the crawler picks up traits from embedded actions on class pages
Classes are not actions/spells; remove num_actions extracted from embedded actions within class page bodies
